summary: Appends node a2 to the tail of a linked list whose head pointer is at this+0xD0. If the head is null the list is empty and a2 becomes the new head; otherwise the walk advances through each node's next pointer at +0x18 until a null next pointer is found (the tail) and sets that tail's next pointer to a2. Void function; called by sub_493480.

local_names.v2: current node while walking toward the tail; starts as the head (this+0xD0)
local_names.i: next node obtained from the current node's next pointer at +0x18
local_names.a2: node to append to the list

operations.description: Load the list head v2 = this[52] (head pointer at this+0xD0).
If the head at this+0xD0 is non-null, walk to the tail and link a2 onto it; otherwise the list is empty and a2 becomes the new head directly.
Walk the list starting from the head's next pointer at +0x18, advancing v2 through each node's next pointer at +0x18 until a null next pointer is reached.
Append a2 as the new tail: set the tail node's next pointer at +0x18 to a2 (the next-pointer slot is reached through the indirect base at this+0xE8).
Empty-list path: set the head at this+0xD0 to a2.
Void function; returns nothing after either append path.
